title: NxSpawn
description: 🏠 Set and teleport to your server’s spawn point with style — lightweight and easy to use!
body:
# 🌍 NxSpawn  
A clean and modern spawn system for every Minecraft server!  

---

## 📦 Plugin Information  
**Name:** NxSpawn  
**Version:** 1.0.0  
**Developer:** NotRenzo  
**Support Server:** [Join Discord](https://dc.gg/nxdevelopment)  
**Minecraft Version:** 1.21+  
**API:** Spigot / Paper  

---

## ✨ Features  
✅ Set your server’s main spawn point with `/setspawn`  
✅ Teleport players to spawn with `/spawn`  
✅ Customizable teleport delay and messages  
✅ Sound and title effects  
✅ Lightweight and lag-free  
✅ Works on all Spigot and Paper versions  

---

## ⚙️ Commands  
`/setspawn` — Set the global spawn location  
`/spawn` — Teleport to the set spawn point  

### 🔒 Permissions  
`nxspawn.set` — Set the spawn (default: OP)  
`nxspawn.use` — Use /spawn (default: true)  

---

## 🛠 Configuration Preview  
```yaml
settings:
  teleport-delay: 3
  teleport-message: "&aTeleporting to spawn in &e{time} &aseconds..."
  cancelled-message: "&cTeleport cancelled!"
  no-spawn-set: "&cNo spawn point set yet!"
  teleported-message: "&aWelcome to spawn!"
```
